svg.text: Breadboard layout: Cmod A7-35T, INMP441, WeAct PCM5100A and the 3.3 V regulator

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Board configuration cmod_a7_35_tiny_vga_640_claude, seen from above. Cmod A7 is at the end of the breadboard, its USB plug off the end; the microphone, the DAC and the 3.3 V regulator of variant B go into the free rows.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tinted holes are the strips in use: the five holes of a strip are connected. A dot is a jumper wire in a hole.

svg.text: +3.3 V from the regulator (variant A: from TPH2). Both + rails and both GND rails are joined at this end.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cmod A7 goes in rows 40 to 63, DIP 25 to 48 in column c and 1 to 24 in column g, so that DIP 24 and 25, VU and GND, are in row 63, the last one: the USB plug is off the end of the breadboard.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TinyVGA lies over rows 28 to 39, its VGA socket facing up; in variant A, Pmod TPH2 between JA and TinyVGA takes about 8 rows more. Keep rows 23 to 39 free of modules.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The wires from DIP 17 to 24 leave their strips by hole j and run left over hole row h to the modules: holes i and j of the GPIO strips stay free. SD crosses the channel past the microphone.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: TM1638 is off the breadboard, on female-to-male wires: STB, CLK and DIO from hole j of rows 51 to 53, VCC and GND from the bottom rails.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: INMP441 goes across the center channel like a 6-pin DIP chip: L/R, WS, SCK in column f, GND, VDD, SD in column e. L/R goes to GND here, so DIP 19 stays free.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The DAC goes in by its header in column j; its body and jack hang over the bottom rails and the edge of the breadboard, so it takes its power from the top rails.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The regulator of variant B is a 3-pin AMS1117-3.3 module, as Amazon B08CDMZMDN, in column j, rows 4 to 6, away from Cmod A7: the one red wire brings it 5 V from DIP 24, VU. Its pin order and outline come from the listing: check the labels.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Variant A, Pmod TPH2: leave the regulator and its 5 V wire out, and wire test point 6 of TPH2 to the + rail. Unplug USB before changing the wiring.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DIP 48 to 26 and 1 to 11 are the GPIO pins of the labs, gpio[0] to gpio[33]; nothing is connected to them here.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WeAct: /SD and MC stay unconnected; the module pulls /SD up and MC down.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Liberation Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Put the module in label side up, its jack toward the edge of the breadboard: WS goes in row 9 and VCC in row 15.
